extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: NWPU-RESISC45 is a large-scale benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification. It contains 31,500 images covering 45 scene classes with 700 images in each class, featuring high variations in spatial resolution, viewpoint, illumination, and background.
extraction.creator: Northwestem Polytechnical University (NWPU)
extraction.citeAs: Gong Cheng, Junwei Han, Xiaoqiang Lu. Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification: Benchmark and State of the Art. Proceedings of the IEEE.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation extracted the images from Google Earth after selecting 45 representative scene classes based on existing datasets and literature searches.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator; Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Google Earth (Google Inc.), which maps the Earth by superimposing images obtained from satellite imagery, aerial photography, and geographic information systems (GIS).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Images were extracted by experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation from Google Earth.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: remote sensing image scene classification; develop and evaluate various data-driven algorithms; natural hazards detection; land use and land cover (LULC) determination; geospatial object detection; geographic image retrieval; vegetation mapping; environment monitoring; urban planning
